title: SHA-1 Hash Generator
h1: SHA-1 Hash Generator — Create SHA1 Digests
description: Generate SHA-1 hashes of any text using the browser's Web Crypto API. Private, instant, and free with no uploads.
intro: Enter text to compute its SHA-1 digest locally. Ideal for checksums or legacy systems that still use SHA-1.
blurb: Compute SHA-1 hashes of text entirely in your browser.
howItWorks: Type or paste the text you want to hash.
Click Generate to compute the SHA-1 digest using Web Crypto.
Copy the hexadecimal hash from the output.
examples: The string 'hello' produces a fixed 40-character hexadecimal SHA-1 value.
Useful when a legacy system expects a SHA-1 checksum.

faq.a: SHA-1 is considered cryptographically broken for security purposes. Use it only for non-security checksums or compatibility with older systems. Prefer SHA-256 for new work.

faq.q: Does the hash leave the browser?
faq.a: No. The digest is calculated locally with the Web Crypto API and never transmitted.
